content.text: Put Nix behind a reverse proxy to serve it on your domain with TLS. Caddy needs three lines:
Collaboration uses WebSockets on the same origin; Caddy forwards them without extra configuration.
Every request passes through the proxy, which routes it by path and host:

flowchart LR
  accTitle: How a request reaches Nix
  Browser -->|HTTPS| Proxy[Reverse proxy]
  Proxy -->|/api| Core[Core API]
  Proxy -->|/collab| Collab[Collaboration]
  Proxy -->|site hosts| Sites[Sites server]
  Core --> Postgres[(Postgres)]
